文件选好就上传到文件中心，页面只保存结果。按要保存的值选组件：FileUploa: A file uploads to the file center as soon as it is picked; the page only keeps the result. Choose the component by the value you store: FileUpload / ImageUpload manage a file list whose entries get url and response (the file-center record, with its id) once uploaded; FileIdUpload's value is the file-center id, and fileUrl(id) gives the address to show it; AvatarUpload's value is the image URL. In forms use FormFileUpload / FormImageUpload / FormAvatarUpload (see the Forms page). Removing a file from the list only drops the reference; the file stays in the file center.
fileList 由页面管理，uploadApi 传 uploadFile；点击: The page owns fileList and passes uploadFile as uploadApi; click or drop files, each shows its progress, and a finished one has its id and url.
缩略图网格，上传中先显示本地预览；到达 limit 后隐藏添加按钮。只取上传成功: A thumbnail grid that shows a local preview while uploading; the add button hides once limit is reached. Save only the URLs of successful uploads.
值是图片 URL：上传后是 /api/admin/files/<id>，也可以手: The value is an image URL: /api/admin/files/<id> after an upload, or an address typed in that starts with http(s):// or /; an empty string once removed.
单个时值是 id 或 null，multiple 时是 id 数组；只有 id: Single: the value is an id or null; with multiple, an array of ids. Given only ids (an edit form), the component looks up the file names. Types and size default to the server settings.
limit、accept、maxSizeMB 在上传前拦下不符合的文件并提示；服: limit, accept and maxSizeMB stop files that don't fit before uploading, with a warning; the server checks again. disabled shows just the list.
最多 5 个，每个不超过 {{size}}MB: Up to 5 files, {{size}}MB each at most
最多 4 张，支持 JPG / PNG / GIF / WebP: Up to 4 images; JPG / PNG / GIF / WebP
点击或拖拽 CSV / TXT 文件到这里: Click or drop CSV / TXT files here
最多 2 个，每个不超过 1MB: Up to 2 files, 1MB each at most
文件列表（受控），见下方 UploadFileItem: The file list (controlled), see UploadFileItem below
添加、上传进度、完成、失败、移除时都会调用: Called on add, upload progress, completion, failure and removal
上传一个文件，返回带 url 的对象；一般传 uploadFile: Uploads one file and returns an object with url; usually uploadFile
最多几个文件；大于 1 时可以多选: Maximum number of files; above 1, several can be picked at once
拖放区文字（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Drop zone text (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
拖放区下方的提示（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Hint under the drop zone (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
只读：隐藏拖放区和移除按钮: Read-only: hides the drop zone and the remove buttons
最多几张；到达上限后隐藏添加按钮: Maximum number of images; the add button hides at the limit
缩略图下方的提示（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Hint under the thumbnails (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
只读：隐藏添加和移除按钮: Read-only: hides the add and remove buttons
头像 URL；空字符串或 null 表示没有头像: Avatar URL; an empty string or null means none
上传后传入 /api/admin/files/<id>，手填地址时传入该地址，移: Gets /api/admin/files/<id> after an upload, the typed address when one is entered, and an empty string on removal
显示名称，没有头像时取首字母: Display name; its first letter shows when there is no image
图片大小上限（MB），默认取服务器上限: Image size limit (MB); defaults to the server's limit
只显示头像，不显示按钮: Shows just the avatar, without buttons
文件中心 id；multiple 时是 id 数组: File-center id; an array of ids with multiple
单个时传入 id 或 null，multiple 时传入 id 数组: Gets an id or null, or an array of ids with multiple
附件列表或图片缩略图: An attachment list or image thumbnails
多个文件（最多 20 个）；否则只能有一个: Several files (up to 20); otherwise just one
允许的扩展名，默认取服务器允许的类型（图片时只取图片类型）: Allowed extensions; defaults to the types the server allows (only image types for images)
单个文件上限（MB），默认取服务器上限: Size limit per file (MB); defaults to the server's limit
上传完成后查看文件的地址: Where to view the file once uploaded
uploadApi 返回的对象；uploadFile 返回 FileRecord: What uploadApi returned; uploadFile returns a FileRecord whose id is the file-center id
本地图片的临时预览地址，上传完成前显示: Temporary preview URL of a local image, shown until the upload finishes
